description:
DONE (s470bq, Opus, 2026-09-05), with its coverage stated.  Grammar in
docs/ir-spec.md Â§12c; the design is docs/plan-speed-and-ir-s470.md Â§B.3.

A foreign backend cannot use PCL's fast SHAPES (`%p-push1`,
`%p-sort-classic`, `p-incf-raw` are SBCL-shaped) but CAN use the PROOF behind
each of them to pick its own.  `--facts` therefore wraps each licensed form:

    (p-fact (foreach-raw) (p-foreach-raw ($v @a) â¦))
    (p-fact (local-push)  (p-push @a $x))          ; under PCL_OPT=none

so `PCL_OPT=none --facts` is the general-form IR with every proof attached.
`p-fact` is a transparent macro (expands to FORM), so the annotation is free
and a consumer that ignores it reads the same program.

THE DESIGN POINT: the FACT is computed BEFORE the switch is consulted at each
wired site.  A gate written `enabled(NAME) && FACT` short-circuits the fact
away, which would make the counterfactual unprintable -- so each site was
rewritten fact-first.  A Kind-B pass gets a second argument, ANNOTATE-ONLY:
`Pl::Passes::run` calls a DISABLED pass under `--facts` so its licence is
still named (Pl/ClassicSort.pm is the worked example).

WIRED (10 + 1): foreach-range, foreach-raw, foreach-arrays, raw-topic,
local-push, classic-sort, tail-return, elem-setf, insensitive-call,
symref-const; numeric-slot is wired but its SITE is only reached because
raw-slot fired, so it does not appear under PCL_OPT=none.

NOT WIRED, and why (task #1216 owns it): the verdict-COVERAGE family
(raw-slot, raw-numeric, str-buffer, raw-block-eval, raw-op-family,
raw-closure-capture, raw-return-family) plus dyn-loop-exit.  Their licence is
not a local form choice -- it is a DECLARATION's class, already in the IR as
`p-let`'s `:class` (#1035).  Printing the counterfactual there means running
the verdict with the switch off, which is a VarAnnotator plumbing change, not
a wrap.

Guard: Pl/t/ir-data-form-01.t asserts the nine switch-independent licences are
named in BOTH modes, and that PCL_OPT=none really emitted the general forms.
